description: Master heroic pose vertical - the canonical reference image
prompt: ECUAMAN heroic mascot of Ecuanutrition. Anatomically accurate Penaeus vannamei (Pacific whiteleg shrimp) reimagined as a Pixar-style underwater superhero. Full body vertical heroic pose, three-quarter facing camera. Segmented orange carapace forming muscular hero torso with sculpted six-pack abs visible on shell plates. Serrated rostrum (saw-like beak) with 8 small dorsal teeth above smiling mouth. Two large expressive cartoon eyes on short eyestalks with white sclera and dark blue iris. Two extra-long flexible antennae longer than the body curving back, ending in feathered tassels with red ribbon outside and yellow ribbon inside in Ecuadorian flag colors tied with brown leather knot. Two short bifurcated antennules. Six clearly defined abdominal segments with natural ventral curve. Fan tail with central pointed telson and lateral uropods open in fan shape. Muscular humanoid arms holding glowing cyan-aqua energy trident vertical in right hand: three symmetric prongs with central one slightly longer, translucent crystal shaft emitting bioluminescent particles and bright plasma halo. Left arm flexed showing bicep. Vibrant golden orange body color hex F39A2B with deep amber hex C2691A shadows and golden hex FFD27A highlights on carapace edges. Royal blue flowing cape hex 0046AD outer with darker hex 002D70 inner billowing dramatically to the right in underwater current attached at shoulders. Electric blue belt hex 1E88E5 with bold white sans-serif text 'ECUAMAN' clearly legible across the front. Circular gold-bordered medallion with gold hex F2C744 ring and white letter E monogram in center on the belt. Deep Pacific Ocean background gradient from hex 001A3D top to hex 003A7D middle. Three diagonal god rays of sunlight descending from upper-left. Drifting plankton and bioluminescent particles in soft bokeh. Cinematic dramatic underwater lighting with cyan rim light from above, warm key light frontal, subsurface scattering on the carapace. DreamWorks Pixar 3D semi-realistic style. Ultra detailed. Proud confident heroic smile. Sharp focus.
